profile_text.body:
Cerence Inc. is a public company headquartered in Burlington, Massachusetts, traded under the ticker CRNC. On its own site the company describes itself as providing conversational and agentic AI-powered user experiences for automotive and beyond, and as a trusted interaction and action layer for physical AI. It says its platform combines voice, multimodal understanding, contextual intelligence, agentic architecture, and governed execution, and that its technology has been developed and deployed at automotive scale.

Products named on the site include Cerence xUI, which the company describes as a multimodal AI foundation that helps OEMs combine speech, vision, and vehicle data to understand driver intent, and Cerence Emergency Vehicle Detection (EVD), which uses audio AI to detect and localize emergency vehicle sirens. The company says EVD is already deployed in production vehicles and can detect more than 1,500 emergency sirens across nearly 50 countries, identifying approaching emergency vehicles from more than 300 meters away with interior microphones and beyond 800 meters when paired with exterior microphones. The site also describes work with Microsoft on Zero Trust and layered AI security for in-car assistants, and names Timo Matheja and Stefan Hamerich in connection with a demonstration of speech signal enhancement for multi-seat in-car environments.

The site reports third quarter results with revenue up 12% year over year, connected services revenue up 20% year over year, and operating cash flow of $20M supporting a first-ever share repurchase program. The company's SEC Central Index Key is 0001768267. No lawsuits or MCP servers are recorded for Cerence.
